findings.issue: `adjoinKinkComponentEquiv_componentOfOutgoing` (182–183), `adjoinKinkComponentEquiv_last` (193), `_symm_componentOfOutgoing` (215) and `_symm_componentOfOutgoing_inr` (223) all close goals about `(adjoinKinkComponentEquiv ..).symm` with `collapseKinkComponent_*` facts. summary: Six proofs close goals by silently unfolding a wrapper (`collapseKinkComponent`'s `Sum.elim`/`Quotient.lift`, or the `.symm.symm` of `Equiv.ofBijective`), with no lemma or comment. Only `adjoinKinkComponentEquiv_symm_inr` does this unfolding explicitly.
